# The Bharath News

> Breaking news from India and GCC regions. Business, technology, sports, entertainment, and community stories in English, Hindi, Malayalam, Tamil, Kannada, Telugu, and Bengali.

## About

The Bharath News is a multilingual digital news platform covering India and the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) regions. We aggregate, curate, and deliver news across multiple categories and regional languages.

## Content Categories

- India News: Politics, economy, and social affairs in India
- GCC News: News from UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman
- Business: Stock markets, economy, corporate news, startups
- Technology: Tech industry, AI, gadgets, startups, digital trends
- Sports: Cricket, football, Olympics, IPL, and other sports
- Entertainment: Bollywood, movies, TV, celebrities, OTT
- Health & Wellness: Medical news, fitness, mental health
- Education: Exams, universities, scholarships, education policy
- Jobs & Careers: Government jobs, private sector, recruitment
- Real Estate: Property market, housing, real estate investment
- World News: International affairs, global politics
- Lifestyle & Travel: Food, fashion, travel destinations

## Languages

Content is available in: English, Hindi, Malayalam, Tamil, Kannada, Telugu, Bengali

## Website

URL: https://www.thebharathnews.com

## API

Articles are available via the website. Each article has a canonical URL at /article/{slug}.

## Contact

Visit https://www.thebharathnews.com for more information.
